convertibility_reason: Uses only built-in iMA indicators (2x SMA), standard Trade library for market orders, simple divergence logic, fixed lot sizing, no grid/martingale, no custom indicators. All logic is straightforward to replicate in Python.

derived_values.name: Divergence
derived_values.formula: dv1 = maF[0] - maS[0]; dv2 = (maF[0] - maS[0]) - (maF[1] - maS[1]); Diver = dv1 - dv2 = (maF[1] - maS[1])

params.note: Default 0 means disabled. When enabled (input Trailing), trails SL at Bid-Trailing for longs and Ask+Trailing for shorts, only when new SL is beyond open price

other_exits: BreakEven: when profit >= BreakEven points, SL moved to open price. Default 0 = disabled.
BasketProfitON: closes ALL positions on account when account profit >= BasketProfit. Default disabled.
BasketLossON: closes ALL positions on account when account loss >= BasketLoss. Default disabled.
SignalCloseBuy and SignalCloseSell both hardcoded to return false - no signal-based close logic

params.note: Fixed lots. MultyOpen allows adding to existing position up to MaxVolume

position_sizing.conditional_logic: If MultyOpen=true and position exists, new lot added only if total volume <= MaxVolume and position type matches signal direction

custom_logic_notes: The Divergence formula simplifies: dv1 = maF[0]-maS[0], dv2 = (maF[0]-maS[0])-(maF[1]-maS[1]), so Diver = dv1 - dv2 = maF[1] - maS[1], which is simply the MA difference on the previous bar. Entry long when DVBuySell <= Diver <= DVStayOut. Entry short when -DVStayOut <= Diver <= -DVBuySell. The CloseBuy/CloseSell signal functions are hardcoded to return false, so positions only exit via SL, TP, trailing, breakeven, or basket profit/loss. StopLevel checks validate that SL/TP prices are beyond the broker's minimum stop level before placing orders.
backtest_data_needs: Any symbol with 5-digit pricing, default timeframe from PERIOD_CURRENT, 730 days
python_conversion_notes: Straightforward conversion. Compute two SMAs (period 7 and 88 on open price), calculate divergence as maF_prev - maS_prev. Generate long signals when divergence is between DVBuySell and DVStayOut; short signals when between -DVStayOut and -DVBuySell. Apply fixed SL/TP of 550 points. Implement trailing stop and breakeven as optional post-entry modifications. Basket profit/loss close is account-level and can be omitted or simplified for single-symbol backtest. New-bar guard means one signal evaluation per completed bar.
